text_block_list.text:
"That day, as I was walking down the hallway
with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Trainer, over there, over there!

Following Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's gaze,
there was student council vice president Air Groove and—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It's Student Council President Symboli Rudolf...!

Symboli Rudolf, the student council president
and the Umamusume Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi looked up to, was there.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President. Regarding the inspection tour proposed by the Chairwoman for next week...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I plan to bring this child along as an introduction as well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heheh! I'm gonna do my best on this inspection with the President too!

Tokai Teio is a Classic Double Crown Umamusume
who conquered the Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).
Though she suffered through an injury-plagued season at one point, she went on to claim GⅠ victories in both the Japan Cup and the Arima Kinen after entering the Senior Class.
In particular, her victory at the Arima Kinen—racing for the first time in a year after suffering an injury—has become legendary as a miraculous comeback.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
To become an "Empress" who surpasses
even the "Emperor" Symboli Rudolf.
Aww, what a truly cool declaration that is~~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, it's so cool how they back up their words with actions.
That miraculous comeback in the Arima Kinen was incredible too!
Like, "I'm the only absolute!"♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! And on top of that,
there's even a rumor she'll be the next student council president!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~! Waaahhhh~~!
So nice, so cool~...!

Like the younger students watching their idol from a distance,
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's eyes shone brightly.
choice_data_list: (I hope someday she can get a little closer to the one she admires...)

text_block_list.text:
At the end of the week of that encounter...
...a single phone call came.

text_block_list.name: Voice on the Phone
text_block_list.text: "Haaah-hah-ha!"

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi on the Phone
text_block_list.text: "Teio-chan!? What are you doing with my phone—!?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Ahem!
Tsuru-chan is in my custody!
If you want to save her, come to the arcade!"

And so, I received an energetic summons
from "Teio-chan."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Over here, over here!
Tsuru-chan's Trainer! Over this way~♪

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi & Teio
text_block_list.text: Hello!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Not that! I'm so sorry on your day off!
Teio-chan, really... geez!
choice_data_list: I don't mind. More importantly, you two seem to get along well.
I don't mind. You two seem really close, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! Tsuru-chan loves the Prez just like I do, so we're comrades! Right~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Plus, there's something I really need to say,
loud and clear, to Tsuru-chan's trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh, to my Trainer!?
From Teio-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Right. Both of you, stand at attention!
Are you ready?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'd definitely love to hear it.
Yeah, I'd love to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright♪
Then let's... get started right away!

text_block_list.name: Photo Sticker Booth
text_block_list.text: "Please choose a photoshoot course♪"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Teio-chan,
what happened to the 'thing you wanted to say'...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"We can worry about that later!
Come on, you two, get in the photo booth!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
Teio-chan~!?

And just like that, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
and I were shoved into the photo booth together...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Um, well... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~.
I don't get it at aaaaall...

text_block_list.name: Photo Sticker Booth
text_block_list.text:
"Alright then, let's start the photoshoot♪
Here's the pose I recommend★"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Should we strike a pose for now?

I limply make a finger heart with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.
Is this really what Tokai Teio intended...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —No, no, noooo!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's what I'm talking about, you two!
When someone says "strike a pose," you gotta...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's obviously this one!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
ââ!!
Teio-chan, that pose isâ

"I recognized that 'pose'. After all,
it was far too famous in the racing world."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—"When she resolves to win,
this Umamusume is an absolute certainty!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That pose is the one President Rudolf did
when she won the Triple Crown...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Shishishi! Tsuru-chan,
your debut's coming up real soon, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now then, you two, prepare yourselves!
Once you debut, the road to the Triple Crown will pass in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And as her Trainer, you must believe in
the "absolute" that lies within Tsuru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ――……I promise.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I had my own absolute, too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No matter where, no matter what condition I'm in,
no matter how impossible or painful the situation,
even if everyone says there's no chance at all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: There's an absolute within you too, Tsuru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So please believe in her. Watch over her, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer is Tsuru-chan's absolute.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
――~~~, alright!
Teio-chan!! Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I will become a Triple Crown Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be an "absolutely" strong Umamusume,
just like President Rudolf with her "absolute strength"!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi! Nice, nice!!
Come on, Tsuru-chan's Trainer too!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Tsuyoshi, let's aim for the Triple Crown!!
Yeah! Tsuyoshi, we're aiming for the Triple Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi & Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO!
I'm getting fired up!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Teio-chan!
Leave doodling on these purikura to me!
I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Triple Crown, Triple Crown—did she do it!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru-chan!? Wh-what...
Trainer, go buy something cold to drink!
Her finger... Tsuru-chan's finger is—!!
And so, they spent the rest of the day playing their hearts out at the arcade—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer!
Thank you so much for all your help yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. And then, you see~...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ta-da!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's the picture of the three of us doing the 'Triple Crown Pose' with Teio-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I set it as my lock screen! Ever since I made that vow that day—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll become "absolute"!
I'll be a Triple Crown Umamusume too!

And she raised three fingers.
With the same bright smile
as the photo set as her wallpaper.
